_comment: OPERATOR-ONLY. Agents must not edit this file; see MISSION.md.
_rationale: Symbols whose honest postcondition is the empty one: their return value provably feeds no correctness argument. Retiring their trust marker with no `ensures` narrows the TCB (the body is verified instead of assumed) rather than hiding an obligation.

_evidence.upstream: all four are plain verified exec fns upstream, with no external_body and no ensures; the markers were added by the skeleton stripper (which inflated external_body from 19 to 189 tree-wide)
_evidence.statics: THREAD_COUNT is a statistics counter never read by a proof; ALIGNED_BASE seeds os_get_aligned_hint, which is advisory by construction
_evidence.measured: removing the four markers with no contract added: 652 -> 656 verified, 0 errors
_evidence.alternative_rejected: a non-vacuous ensures would require an atomic value model that vstd std_specs deliberately does not expose, i.e. it would invent TCB rather than retire it
